offences.quote: Using an AI tool to gain an unfair advantage by misrepresenting its work as your own is academic misconduct and can have serious consequences.
When incorporating AI-generated content into your own work, you must acknowledge it by providing correct references. If you fail to do so this may result in academic misconduct.
It can also include using ghostwriters (including AI tools), research misconduct, and exam misconduct, as well as all other kinds of cheating to gain an unfair academic advantage.
